args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest production deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1, the service failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging. checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, and don't redeploy v2.3.1 until it's fixed.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **Problem:** Since the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. All three regions now run v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and has paged on-call. It records the failure, the rollback and the next steps.

v2.3.1 was also unhealthy as a release candidate in staging (v2.3.1-rc), so it went to production after already failing there. Don't redeploy it until the root cause is fixed.
